contract.label_scope: Publisher recording labels; not audible-event truth
contract.scope: Additional DEVELOPMENT calibration after observing coarse-grid failures. No new final assessment; no neural weights retrained; default unchanged.
contract.selection: For each on-hit count 1/2, set threshold to the (floor(.05*Nneg)+1)th largest negative recording activation statistic plus a 1e-5 numerical margin. Select maximal development recall within the 5% negative-file budget, then lower threshold, lower FPR, two hits. Off threshold .75×on, two off hits.

limitations: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY spectrogram experiment. Publisher recording labels; no fresh independent assessment, event timing, range or field-reliability claim.

training.objective: Positive bag: softplus(-max window logit); negative bag: mean softplus(window logit); balanced class and equal recording mass
